item.title: Israeli strikes on Lebanon likely to continue 'until we get any clarity' on US-Iran agreement
item.description: Israeli forces carried out airstrikes on several areas in south Lebanon on June 17 despite an agreement on a peace deal in the Middle East war that includes Lebanon. But the contents of the deal have yet to be revealed, although the US has confirmed Israel will not have to withdraw to the international border with Lebanon. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more from Jerusalem.

item.title: Iran war 'has been a strategic disaster for the State of Israel', analyst says
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is on a collision course with Donald Trump as the US president seeks to extricate himself from the Iran war, with both men's goals unmet and Israeli military operations tied down in Lebanon. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Aaron David Miller, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, says that "this has been a strategic disaster for the state of Israel. item.title: With Iran deal, Trump told ships to 'start your engines.' That's not happening yet
item.description: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted global pain during the months-long conflict with the U.S. and Israel. A tentative deal is in place, but questions remain about the key waterway.

item.title: Trump's Iran agreement dominates G7 but big questions remain
item.description: The U.S.-Israel-led war in Iran has rocked the global economy and decimated Trump's standing at home

item.title: What we know about the US-Iran memorandum of understanding
item.description: The United States and Iran, ⁠as well as mediator Pakistan, ​have provided few details about the preliminary deal announced Sunday to bring an end to the US-Iran conflict that has engulfed the region and threatened global energy supplies.

item.title: Israel to stay ‘indefinitely’ in lands seized in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria
item.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Monday that Israeli ground forces would remain in land they hold in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, potentially challenging a memorandum of understanding announced a day earlier between the US and Iran to end the war in the Middle East.

item.title: הסכם נועצים בין ארה"ב לאיראן מעלה זעם בישראל, ומפקדיו יוצאים נגד נתניהו
item.description: ישראלים מכל הספקטרום הפוליטי הגיבו בעצבנות לחדשות ההסכם, וקראו לו "מזחל" לישראל.

item.title: איראן: הסכם לסוף מלחמה עם ארצות הברית תלוי בנטישת ישראל מלבנון
item.description: שר החוץ של איראן אמר כי ההסכם הדחוק לסוף המלחמה עם ארצות הברית יתנאל בנטישת ישראל מלבנון – תנאי שישראל דחתה כבר, ואשר עלול לערער את ההסכם ולהחמיר את המלחמה.

item.title: Netanyahu's Israel grapples with Trump-Iran deal as details remain unclear
item.description: Defense Minister Katz says IDF will remain in Lebanon security zones as Israeli leaders debate Trump-Iran deal's impact on national security interests.

item.title: ישראל מחששת: טראמפ עייף מנתניהו ועומד ל'הפוך' בעקבות הסכם עם איראן: מומחה
item.description: מומחה אומר שמחששים גדלים בירושלים, שנשיא ארצות הברית עומד ל'הפוך' מעמדו של נתניהו, בעקבות חיכוכי הסכם עם איראן, והתקפות בביירות.
